articleTitle: Gong Homepage Teardown: Jan 2020 to Jun 2026
h1: How Gong rewrote its homepage over 6 years

analysis-blocks.label: Jan 2020 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: product-led messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "REVENUE INTELLIGENCE" — direct product statement.
Visible section headings include: "Get powerful visibility into your customer interactions with", "Revenue Intelligence helps you fuel:", "So What Does this look like? Glad you asked.".
Navigation includes: "Log In", "What is RI?", "Overview", "Reveal: The RI Podcast" — product category framing.
Section headings later removed include: "Get powerful visibility into your customer interactions with" and "Revenue Intelligence helps you fuel:".

analysis-blocks.label: Jun 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: updated positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "Revenue AI Built To Predict churnPredict churn" — updated value proposition.
New section headings include: "Trusted by 5,000+ customers", "Winning GTM organizations run revenue on Gong", "Pitchbook is 10x more efficient with revenue AI".
CTAs no longer present include: "Watch Video", "Paul Santarelli VP of Sales", "Bevin Lyon VP, Customer Strategy".

messaging.after: Revenue AI Built To Predict churnPredict churn
messaging.note: This change can be read as a deliberate update to the primary value proposition frame. No confirmed strategy is implied.

messaging.before: Generate more revenue by having better sales conversations with the #1 revenue intelligence platform for sales optimization.
messaging.after: Gong Revenue AI OS helps your entire GTM organization win. Drive growth with multimodal revenue signal processing, specialized AI agents, and purpose-built applications.
messaging.note: Meta description updated. The change in framing may reflect a positioning adjustment or an SEO update.

messaging.before: Revenue Intelligence Technology for Sales Teams | Gong.io

snapshots.above_fold_structure: Full-bleed gradient background with large illustrated characters on right, bold headline 'REVENUE INTELLIGENCE' on left, small tagline and CTA button below.
Split layout with headline and CTA on left, interactive chat widget mockup on right, soft gradient background, navigation bar with logo and sign-in.

visual-analysis.visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from a full-bleed cinematic hero with illustrated characters and bold messaging to a cleaner, more professional multi-column layout emphasizing product interface mockups and social proof through client logos. The visual language shifted from lifestyle imagery to product-centric UI demonstration.
